title: Suffolk House, Penang
geometryBasis: The current named building footprint fixes all four sides. The public-domain historic view and restoration record establish the wrapping galleries and recessed solid core.
sectionBasis: Shown are the ground-floor open semicircular arcades, paired upper columns, dark timber doors, parapet and high center jack roof. The conservation record specifies limewash and clay tiles.
limitations: Bay spacing, upper railings and less visible joinery are approximated from the published plate and conservation text. The recorded building includes the main house and excludes later detached wings and landscaping.
The coarse elevation model includes vegetation and roof returns. Stair risers, finished floors and the shallow terrace are authored from the exterior references rather than measured by the DEM.
